'''Niak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[analyst]] and aide to [[Ambassador]] [[Ileris Tik'kla]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Niak appears in the opening story in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2015]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[Desperate Allies]]''.
